```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", "scenario_evppi_results.rds")

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  evppi_cache <- readRDS(cache_file)
  evppi_all <- evppi_cache$evppi_all_scenarios
  cat("Loaded scenario EVPPI results:", nrow(evppi_all), "rows\n")
  cat("Available scenarios:", paste(unique(evppi_all$scenario_id), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Available models:", paste(unique(evppi_all$model_label), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Available parameters:", paste(unique(evppi_all$parameter), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  data_available <- TRUE
} else {
  warning("Scenario EVPPI cache not found: ", cache_file,
          "\nPlease run script 14_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.")
  data_available <- FALSE
}
```

```{r build-grouped-data, include=FALSE}
evppi_grouped <- data.frame()

if (data_available) {
  # Filter to Model B (focused) and the 3 target scenarios
  target_scenarios <- c("base", "s1_decreased_nivo", "s2_wtp100k")

  scenario_labels <- c(
    "base" = "Base case\n(\u20AC51,000/QALY)",
    "s1_decreased_nivo" = "Biosimilar pricing\n(\u20AC51,000/QALY)",
    "s2_wtp100k" = "Elevated threshold\n(\u20AC100,000/QALY)"
  )

  # Map individual parameters to publication groups
  # Interaction coefficients -> "Biomarker x Treatment interaction"
  # Prevalence parameters -> "Biomarker prevalence"
  # Drug costs -> "Drug costs"
  # Utilities -> "Utilities"
  interaction_params <- c("b_crp_rx_os", "b_crp_rx_pfs",
                          "b_tlr_rx_os", "b_tlr_rx_pfs",
                          "b_tmb_braf_rx_os", "b_tmb_braf_rx_pfs")
  prevalence_params <- c("p_crp", "p_tlr", "p_tmb_braf")
  drug_cost_params <- c("c_drug_nivo", "c_drug_FLOX")
  utility_params <- c("u_np", "u_p")

  evppi_filtered <- evppi_all %>%
    filter(model_label == "focused",
           scenario_id %in% target_scenarios)

  # Check for [GROUP] entries first, otherwise use individual parameters
  has_groups <- any(grepl("^\\[GROUP\\]", evppi_filtered$parameter))

  if (has_groups) {
    # Use [GROUP] entries where available
    group_mapping <- c(
      "[GROUP] interaction_crp" = "Biomarker x Treatment interaction",
      "[GROUP] interaction_tlr" = "Biomarker x Treatment interaction",
      "[GROUP] interaction_tmb_braf" = "Biomarker x Treatment interaction",
      "[GROUP] drug_costs" = "Drug costs",
      "[GROUP] utilities" = "Utilities",
      "[GROUP] prevalence" = "Biomarker prevalence"
    )

    evppi_mapped <- evppi_filtered %>%
      filter(parameter %in% names(group_mapping)) %>%
      mutate(param_group = group_mapping[parameter])
  } else {
    # Fall back to individual parameters
    evppi_mapped <- evppi_filtered %>%
      mutate(param_group = case_when(
        parameter %in% interaction_params ~ "Biomarker x Treatment interaction",
        parameter %in% prevalence_params ~ "Biomarker prevalence",
        parameter %in% drug_cost_params ~ "Drug costs",
        parameter %in% utility_params ~ "Utilities",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      filter(!is.na(param_group))
  }

  # Aggregate within groups (sum individual EVPPIs)
  evppi_grouped <- evppi_mapped %>%
    group_by(param_group, scenario_id) %>%
    summarise(
      evppi_pop = sum(evppi_population_millions, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      scenario_label = factor(
        scenario_labels[scenario_id],
        levels = scenario_labels
      )
    )

  cat("Grouped EVPPI data:", nrow(evppi_grouped), "rows\n")
  cat("Parameter groups:", paste(unique(evppi_grouped$param_group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r create-evppi-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  # Order parameter groups by total EVPPI (descending)
  group_order <- evppi_grouped %>%
    group_by(param_group) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(evppi_pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(total) %>%
    pull(param_group)

  evppi_grouped$param_group <- factor(evppi_grouped$param_group, levels = group_order)

  scenario_colors <- c(
    "Base case\n(\u20AC51,000/QALY)" = "#66C2A5",
    "Biosimilar pricing\n(\u20AC51,000/QALY)" = "#FC8D62",
    "Elevated threshold\n(\u20AC100,000/QALY)" = "#8DA0CB"
  )

  p_evppi <- ggplot(evppi_grouped,
                    aes(x = param_group, y = evppi_pop, fill = scenario_label)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("\u20AC", format(x, big.mark = ","), "M")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_colors, name = "Scenario") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Population EVPPI (EUR millions)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  print(p_evppi)
} else {
  cat("EVPPI data not available. Please run script 14_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.\n")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure5.png"),
    plot = p_evppi,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure5.png"), "\n")
}
```
